svg.text: Biometric attendance system · Hardware · Firmware · Desktop Application · DBMS · Cloud
admin & teacher REST APIs: CRUD, attendance sessions, manual override,
reports & defaulters, bulk CSV import, grades, timetable, audit log
schema init & migration · seeds RBAC · auto-creates student logins
DESKTOP APPLICATION — Python 3.12 · Flask · pywebview native window (127.0.0.1:5000)
DBMS — MySQL 8.0 · database: gwasoat · connected as gwasoat_user
admin → * (all) · teacher → course / attendance / report / grade
student → self.* (read-only) · checked by auth.py on every request
gw_admin → ALL · gw_teacher → SELECT + write attendance & grades
gw_student → SELECT on own-data views only
Syllabus coverage: ER/EER · DDL · DML · aggregation & joins · views · nested queries · procedures & functions · triggers · cursors
HARDWARE — Custom PCB v2.0 (85×55 mm, 2-layer, KiCad)
templates for the active course are loaded per session · matches are sent back to the app
soft-latch power hold · battery level monitoring
URL from GWASOAT_CLOUD_URL · key from GWASOAT_API_KEY
fingerprint templates + attendance backed up off-device
